modules.title: Introduction to Adabin Rubutu (Written Literature)
modules.html:
Hausa prose, poetry and drama. This section covers introduction to adabin rubutu (written literature).

Key points

  • Wanne ne madaidacin rubutu na ranar haihuwa — Ranar haihuwa.

Worked examples

Q: Wanne ne madaidacin rubutu na ranar haihuwa?
A: Ranar haihuwa — Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ranar haihuwa.

Q: Menene ma'anar kalmar 'Alhamis'?
A: Thursday — In the Hausa calendar, 'Alhamis' corresponds to Thursday.

More key points

  • Wanne ne madaidacin rubutu na ranar haihuwa — Ranar haihuwa.

quiz.q: Wanne ne madaidacin rubutu na ranar haihuwa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Ranar haihuwa.

quiz.q: Menene ma'anar kalmar 'Alhamis'?
quiz.solution: In the Hausa calendar, 'Alhamis' corresponds to Thursday.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Daidaitacciyar Hausa' (Standard Hausa)?
quiz.solution: The Kano dialect is generally accepted as the basis for Standard Written Hausa.

quiz.q: Wanene 'Malam' a cikin al'ummar Hausawa?
quiz.solution: 'Malam' refers to an educated person, teacher, or religious scholar.

quiz.q: Wanne ne sunan babban birnin jihar Kano?
quiz.solution: The capital of Kano State is Kano city.

quiz.q: Cika wannan: ' muke nufi.'
quiz.solution: The plural verb marker 'muke' corresponds to the first-person plural pronoun 'Mu' (We).

quiz.q: Mene ne ma'anar 'K'ungiyar asiri'?
quiz.solution: 'K'ungiyar asiri' refers to a secret society or cult.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Aure'?
quiz.solution: Aure is the legal union between a man and a woman.

quiz.q: Wanne ne 'fi'ili' (verb) a cikin wannan jimlar: 'Yarinya tana gudu'?
quiz.solution: 'Gudu' (running) is the action word in the sentence.

quiz.q: Wanne ne sunan dabba mai wuya (neck) mai tsayi?
quiz.solution: 'Rakumin dawa' is the Hausa name for a Giraffe.

quiz.q: Wace rana ce 'Tuesday' a Hausa?
Jam'in 'Doki' shi ne:
Tuwo ana yin sa da:
Menene 'Market'?
Fura ana yi da:
Me ake nufi da 'Aure'?
Menene kishiyar kalmar 'Fari'?
Wane ne Allah?
Wanne ne 'Wata'?
Wane kaya ne na gargajiya maza ke sanyawa a kasar Hausa?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Babban riga.

quiz.q: Mene ne 'Dambe'?
quiz.solution: Past question (JAMB 2024). Correct answer: Wasar kokuwa ko bugu.

quiz.q: Wanne ne daga cikin waɗannan ba siffar Tatsuniya ba ne?
Ana kiran mahalicci da:
Mene ne kishiyar 'Maza'?
Mene ne 'Sun' da Hausa?
Sarkin Musulmi location:
Haram meat:
Menene 'God'?
